title: Trek: A self-hosted travel/trip planner with real-time collaboration, interactive maps, PWA support
description:
Group trip planning always collapses into a Google Sheet nobody updates and a group chat full of forwarded confirmation emails. TREK is a self-hosted travel planner built specifically for that problem. You get a beautiful drag-and-drop itinerary, interactive maps, and real-time collaboration! It even tracks your flights, budgets, and packing lists. The best part? Your friends can install it directly to their phones without the App Store! 

https://github.com/mauriceboe/TREK

#github #opensource
